# Resources

## General resources{.unnumbered}

**Official documentation**<br>
The [official documentation](https://git-scm.com/docs){target="_blank"} on Git has extensive documentation on how to use each specific command. It also includes the freely available book [Pro Git]( https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2){target="_blank"}, which is an excellent resource for getting a better understanding of what Git is and how it works.

**Tutorials**
[www.atlassian.com/git](https://www.atlassian.com/git)
[boot.dev](https://www.boot.dev/) has two great courses on Git.

**Git exercises**<br>
<https://gitexercises.fracz.com/>{target="_blank"}
